objective: Validate and review the first eligible post-repair turn, complete STARTUP-003 prospectively, and advance the multi-turn live retest without inferring useful time.
acceptance_criteria: Predecessor RUNS record passes the validator.
A readable review row is appended with UNKNOWN fields preserved.
STARTUP-003 boundaries are recorded prospectively and invalid samples remain excluded.
Integrated CI evidence is inspected or a concrete independent verification is completed.
Current turn reaches the bounded close rule with verified continuation.
checkpointable_substeps: Validate predecessor RUNS and derive its review row only from durable evidence.
Append the first operator review row and record STARTUP-003 first useful boundary.
Inspect integrated CI or execute equivalent repository-data verification.
Use remaining budget on the next unaccepted live-retest evidence item.
handoff_boundary: Second eligible live turn closed with 368 strict useful seconds and exact-second +60s continuation.
early_finish_fallback: Extend reporting tests to generate validity-aware operator review rows from durable ledgers, then integrate into CI.
